script: 1. Stock market this week. The Nifty gained 2.61 percent this week. Here is the full week, by index, sector and market cap.
2. The Nifty closed the week at 25,801. Bank Nifty outperformed, up 5.90 percent.
3. By market cap, large caps did best, up 2.22 percent, and micro caps fell the most, down 2.76 percent.
4. Among sectors, Nifty PSU Bank led, up 6.72 percent. Nifty Metal was the weakest, down 2.98 percent.
5. In large caps, Max Healthcare jumped 14.14 percent, and Muthoot Finance fell 10.19 percent.
6. In mid caps, Blue Star jumped 12.84 percent, and Paytm fell 10.30 percent.
7. In small caps, DEEPAKFERT jumped 13.90 percent, and Kaynes Technology India fell 15.16 percent.
8. In micro caps, Greaves Cotton jumped 18.74 percent, and GNG Electronics fell 18.51 percent.
9. Foreign institutions bought 32,647 crore rupees over the week. Domestic institutions sold 12,698 crore rupees.
10. For the full details, visit our page, and follow Ticker Market India for the week in review every Saturday.
